tara: quick flag from the nightly orphan scan
I found 5 admin principals with no owner; posting concise table and a proposed low-risk plan.

tara: ```
PRINCIPAL           ROLE   LAST_ACTIVE
svc-config-agent     admin 2025-10-12
svc-sync-relay       admin 2024-12-01
svc-telemetry-proxy  admin 2025-02-20
user:qa-bot           admin 2025-07-01
svc-retention-worker admin 2023-06-11
```

tara: command used: `rbac-find --role admin --ownerless --since 2023-01-01`

evan: thanks. quick ask: any KMS decrypt grants for svc-config-agent or retention-worker? want to know if they hold production secrets.

morgan: pasted minimal audit snippet for svc-config-agent: 

morgan: ```
2025-10-12T07:11Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-config-agent key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/config
2025-09-01T00:05Z auth.token_issued principal=svc-config-agent
```

infra: retention-worker shows no recent KMS activity; last decrypt 2023-06-10. likely safe to suspend.

evan: propose: owner outreach 3bd -> staging suspend 24h smoke -> prod canary 48h -> if green, rotate keys (where present) and remove admin role. create SEC-6102 and add checklist.

tara: created SEC-6102 "ownerless-admins: quick triage" and assigned to @morgan and @evan. I added `kms-grant-export` and `staging-canary` to the ticket.

infra: running `kms-grant-check --principals svc-config-agent,svc-sync-relay --since 2023-01-01` now; will attach output to SEC-6102.

audit-bot: policy note: principals flagged will be auto-added to the "recert-pending" tag in 3d if no owner is recorded.

evan: ok locking plan. if partner or external bindings show up during infra dump, we'll move to coordinated window. otherwise start outreach tomorrow.

tara: thanks all  will follow up in SEC-6102 with infra artifacts and owner outreach copy.
